title: ForeverCraft+
description: A modern take on Vanilla+ Minecraft focusing on client/server-side mods only -- made with the idea of "Forever Worlds" in mind.
body:
# A modern take on Vanilla+ Minecraft!

_Welcome to ForeverCraft+!_

ForeverCraft+ aims to to introduce commonly used QoL, quality, and optimization mods/resource packs/shaders in an easy-to-use package -- making long-term "forever worlds" more accessible to those who like a modded experience. Due to this modpack being entirely client/server-side, transferring your worlds to newer versions of Minecraft as they release is quick and easy with no compatibility issues!

![A distant bay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b51b373dff64b183f9df5c002bdb148c7d729b11.jpeg)
_ForeverCraft+ with Distant Horizons enabled and with included shaders_
### An Optimized Experience:
- Sodium
- Lithium
- Spark
- Chunky
- Concurrent Chunk Management
- GPU Booster
- Attribute Fix
- Packet Fixer
- Immediately Fast
- Fast Quit
- _& more!_

### Enjoy Enhanced Quality:
- 3D Skin Layers
- Entity Model/Texture Features
- Better Clouds
- Particle Rain
- Visuality
- Sleek UI
- Distant Horizons (Optional)
- Fresh Animations (Resource Pack)
- Included shaders
- Enhanced font
- _& more!_

### Plenty of QoL!
- Inventory Sorter
- Client Tweaks
- Inventory Trash Slot
- Axiom (terraforming)
- Starter Kit
- Better Days
- Show Me Your Skin!
- Smooth GUI
- Immerive Hotbar
- Just Zoom
- JEI
- Dynamic Crosshair
- _& more!_

_**Check out the gallery:**_ https://modrinth.com/modpack/forevercraft+/gallery

### A "Forever World":

If you're looking to start a long-term "Forever World," ForeverCraft+ is the perfect way to start! Enjoy modded Minecraft with FC+'s vanilla-friendly enhancements that focus on improving the classic "feel" of vanilla Minecraft without sacrificing its charm.



_(**NOTE**: All credit goes to the original mod-makers. I had no hand in creating any of the mods in this pack, I simply put them in a collection together. This pack is unmonetized and I do not collect any money from its proceeds)._
